items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, Histaklut Penimit 8:1
items.html:
It begins to explain the order of the emanation of the ten Sefirot that emerge one below the other, called AA, AVI [Aba ve Ima] and ZON, or Galgalta, AB, SAG, MA and BON, which are caused one from the other by way of cause and consequence, and it contains three matters: 1. That the first ten Sefirot that emerged after the restriction are called Adam Kadmon. 2. That Adam Kadmon is called the world of Keter, because phase four serves in it for the coupling by striking. 3. The coupling for every Partzuf takes place in the Partzuf above it.

Explanation of the cause of the emanation of the five Partzufim Galgalta, AB, SAG, MA, BON, and their emergence one from the other
Now we shall explain the order of the emanation of the Partzufim one from the other, and how they are caused one from the other by way of the necessity of “precedent and consequent.” And in order to shorten the language and widen the meaning, we shall call the five phases of the Rosh [head] by the names: Galgalta, Einayim, Ozen, Hotem, Peh. And the five phases of the Guf [body] by the names: Keter, Hochma, Bina, ZA, and Malchut. And the matter of the refining of the screen we shall call by the name “ascent,” for ascent means refining, as is known; and when we wish, for example, to say that phase four was refined into phase three, we shall say that Malchut ascended to ZA. And be careful not to forget this.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, Histaklut Penimit 8:2
items.html:
The four fillings that are in the four letters of HaVaYaH, which are AB, SAG, MA, BON
And the names of the five Partzufim — AA, Aba, Ima, ZA, Nukva — we shall call by the names: Galgalta, AB, SAG, MA, BON, which is according to the gematria of the four fillings that pertain in the name HaVaYaH. And the Partzuf AA, who is the Keter, we shall call Galgalta. And the Partzuf Aba, who is Hochma, also called AVI, we shall call AB, which is the secret of HaVaYaH in the filling of Yodin, thus: Yod, Hei, Vav, Hei, which totals in gematria seventy-two [AB]. And the Partzuf Ima, who is Bina, also called Yeshsut, we shall call by the name SAG, which is the secret of HaVaYaH in the filling of Yodin with one Alef in the Vav, thus: Yod, Hei, Vav, Hei, which totals sixty-three [SAG]. And the Partzuf ZA we shall call by the name MA, which is the secret of HaVaYaH in the filling of Alfin, thus: Yod, Hei, Vav, Hei, which totals forty-five [MA]. And the Partzuf of the Nukva, who is Malchut, we shall call by the name BON, which is HaVaYaH in the filling of Heyin, thus: Yod, Hei, Vav, Hei. And the reason for these fillings and their calculations has already been explained in the books Panim Meirot uMasbirot on Etz Chaim, in the explanation of the 288 sparks, and we shall not elaborate on this here.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, Histaklut Penimit 8:3
items.html:
The first ten Sefirot in the Kav of Ein Sof are called the world of Adam Kadmon. Its stature extends to Keter. The coupling for every Partzuf must be in the one above it
And this you already know, that the first ten Sefirot that were emanated after the restriction are called by the name Adam Kadmon, and it has in it five Partzufim: Galgalta, AB, SAG, MA and BON. Each one of them has in it: Rosh, Toch, Sof, as was explained above. And it, in its entirety, is called the world of Keter, or the world of Adam Kadmon. And the reason it is entirely called Keter has already been explained in the Inner Light (Sub Header, “And it has been explained”), namely, that it is because the screen of phase four in its true measure does not serve in any world besides it, see there. And you should know that the coupling by striking for the ten Sefirot of the Rosh of every Partzuf must be in the Peh of the Rosh of the Partzuf above it, in the manner the ARI explained here (in Part 3, item 12) regarding the four worlds ABYA, that the coupling for the sake of the ten Sefirot of Atzilut is made in the world above Atzilut, which is AK; and for the sake of Beria the coupling is made in Atzilut, and so forth, see there.
